gloss: way of cutting; cutting technique; how to cut

definitions.gloss: way of cutting; cutting technique; how to cut
definitions.explanation: The method or manner of cutting something — typically food in a cooking context, but also paper, fabric, or hair. Formed by the verb {切|き}る (to cut) + {方|かた} (way of doing).

examples.japanese: {玉|たま}ねぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧。
examples.english: Teach me how to cut an onion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{切|き}り{方|かた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: How you cut the ingredients changes the taste of the dish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{切|き}り{方|かた}⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食感|しょっかん}→食感：06636_shokkan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{見|み}た{目|め}→見た目：14110_mitame⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: With sashimi, just a change in how you cut it can dramatically alter the texture and appearance.

notes:
An instance of the productive verb-stem + ⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ pattern meaning "way of doing X" (cf. ⟦{食|た}べ{方|かた}→食べ方：27437_tabekata⟧ "way of eating," ⟦{書|か}き{方|かた}→書き方：13054_kakikata⟧ "way of writing"). Most commonly used in cooking, where the cutting technique has a named system of styles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {切|き}り{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}える→教える：00526_oshieru⟧: to teach someone how to cut
- {切|き}り{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧: to learn how to cut
- ⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧{切|き}り{方|かた}: the correct cutting method

CUTTING STYLES (examples):
- ⟦みじん{切|ぎ}り→みじん切り：07472_mijingiri⟧: fine mince
- せん{切|ぎ}り: julienne
- ⟦{輪切|わぎ}り→輪切り：07474_wagiri⟧: round slices
- ⟦{薄|うす}{切|ぎ}り→薄切り：07475_usugiri⟧: thin slices
- ⟦{乱切|らんぎ}り→乱切り：08067_rangiri⟧: random/rolling cut
